title: Anenji HHS-11kW Grid Power proxy and cloud correlation
summary: A proxy capture from the exact layout-3/model-29440 HHS variant showed the manufacturer cloud repeatedly reading holding register 340 as Grid Power. Two captured values, 1729 W and 1709 W, matched the corresponding DESSMonitor export exactly. The compatible family register 204 remained zero and is not the Grid Power source for this fingerprint.
